cards.title: One h1, then h2s
cards.body: A page usually has one `<h1>` for its title, then `<h2>` headings for its sections, like chapters in a book.

hi.title: Ek h1, phir h2s
hi.body: Page mein aksar title ke liye ek `<h1>` hota hai, phir sections ke liye `<h2>` headings, jaise kitaab ke chapters.

cards.title: Pick by meaning, not size
cards.body: Screen readers and search engines use your headings to understand the page. Choose the level for what the heading is, and change its size later with CSS.

hi.title: Size nahi, matlab dekh kar chuno
hi.body: Screen readers aur search engines page samajhne ke liye aapki headings use karte hain. Level wahi chuno jo heading sach mein hai, aur size baad mein CSS se badlo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: This page breaks the heading rule. Tap the line to fix.

bug.fix: A page has just one `<h1>`. Day two is a section like day one, so it is an `<h2>`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Yeh page heading ka rule todta hai. Jo line theek karni hai us par tap karo.
hi.fix: Page mein sirf ek `<h1>` hota hai. Day two bhi day one jaisa ek section hai, isliye woh `<h2>` hai.

check.question: Which heading should a page's main title use?
check.explanation: The main title is the most important heading on the page, so it gets `<h1>`.

hi.question: Page ke main title ke liye kaunsi heading honi chahiye?
hi.explanation: Main title page ki sabse important heading hai, isliye use `<h1>` milta hai.

exercise.prompt: Make a page titled `My hobbies` with an `<h1>`, then two sections. Each section has an `<h2>` and a paragraph.
exercise.promptHi: `My hobbies` title wala page banao, ek `<h1>` ke saath, phir do sections. Har section mein ek `<h2>` aur ek paragraph ho.
